prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE CLOSED DOOR terrain component for one square tabletop dungeon cell. Square PNG ideally 1024x1024 with TRUE transparent alpha everywhere outside masonry and door; no floor, no circular base. Very steep overhead three-quarter camera, north up, geometry aligned to square screen axes, soft fixed upper-left light, matte hand-painted miniature finish matching pale chipped limestone wall reference. HORIZONTAL wall axis runs left-right across the middle of the cell; passage would run north-south. Two compact pale grey limestone jambs on left and right of middle, between them a clearly CLOSED thick oak door leaf spans left-to-right and blocks that passage. The leaf is upright but viewed steeply from above so its thick wood top edge and a modest front face are visible. Warm desaturated brown oak planks, two plain dark iron straps, a small simple ring handle; no lock icon or barred gates. No lintel overhead hiding the opening; cutaway dollhouse construction. Wood leaf MUST join both stone jambs with no traversable central gap. Entire component, including its short south-side thickness and shadows, fits inside x8..92%, y12..88% canvas. Use broad simple masses readable at 48px. Short side faces reveal raised obstacle; do not depict a flat floor hatch. No arch extending upward off cell, no surrounding room or backdrop, no scenic rubble, inscriptions, runes, arrows, numbering, rank/selection marks, faction colors or watermark. This is a closed ordinary doorway, not sealed or magical. One asset, not before/after pair.
processing: Copy original unchanged; small-size whole-canvas resampling only. No alpha extraction, relighting, recolouring, rotation, or painted geometry.
